headline: Cycle Index Holds at 56 in Complacency as Bitcoin Trades at $82,394
narrative: The desk reading on Monday was Complacency, with the flow cycle index at 56 and the trend flat. Bitcoin traded at $82,394, the Fear and Greed Index stood at 69, and the dollar index was 102.56. That greed reading and a volatility index of 15.2 do not confirm a shift into Thrill, and they do not confirm the advisory suggestion of Disbelief.
author: jordan
